Investor Michael Burry Warns of AI Bubble Benefiting the Wealthy

Investor Michael Burry, known for predicting the 2008 financial crisis, has stated that a bubble in artificial intelligence (AI) would disproportionately benefit the wealthy. He suggested that companies are attempting to create a crisis around AI. Another investor, Steve Eisman, also commented on AI, indicating that companies are trying to manufacture a crisis. Both investors' remarks focus on the potential economic implications and market dynamics surrounding AI development.
